toegepas.voor: Dit is nie 'n wet nie en dit staan nie in die Grondwet nie
toegepas.na: Dit is nie 'n wet nie, en dit staan nie in die Grondwet nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma goes before 'en' when it joins two clauses that each have a subject and verb ('Dit is', 'dit staan').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('Dit is', 'dit staan').
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain punctuation fix required by the AWS 2017 rule, with no word of the definition changed.

toegepas.voor: Om 'n kind seksueel te misbruik is misbruik
toegepas.na: Om 'n kind seksueel te misbruik, is misbruik
toegepas.rede_vinder: When an om-te clause is the subject, a comma goes before the main verb, as the lesson already does in 'Wat hierdie deel gee, is'.
toegepas.fout: No comma between the sentence-initial om-te subject clause and the main verb, so 'misbruik is misbruik' runs together on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain punctuation fix that matches the lesson's own 'Wat hierdie deel gee, is' and leaves every word of the entry and its protected phrases intact.

toegepas.voor: Om 'n kind te boelie is misbruik
toegepas.na: Om 'n kind te boelie, is misbruik
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same rule as the sentence before it: a comma after an om-te subject clause, so the two parallel sentences match; 'boelie' stays as it is.
toegepas.fout: Same missing comma after the om-te subject clause as in the sentence before it.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same punctuation fix as change 4, keeping the two parallel sentences consistent, with 'boelie' untouched.

laat_vaar.blok: As 'n reg nie nagekom word nie
laat_vaar.voor: maar dit gebeur nie altyd vanself nie
laat_vaar.na: maar dit word nie altyd vanself nagekom nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'dit' points back to 'n reg', and a right does not 'happen' in Afrikaans (an English echo); 'nagekom' is the verb the block heading and the next sentence use, so the meaning stays the same.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'dit gebeur nie vanself nie' is a natural Afrikaans idiom here, while the proposal puts 'nagekom' three times in a row (heading, this sentence, the next) and pairs a passive with 'vanself' awkwardly, so it is a lateral move that disturbs its neighbour.

laat_vaar.blok: Die handves en die Grondwet langs mekaar
laat_vaar.voor: Lees die Grondwet se deel oor kinders langs die handves en jy sien
laat_vaar.na: Lees die Grondwet se deel oor kinders langs die handves, en jy sien
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The 'en' joins an imperative clause to a full clause with its own subject and verb ('jy sien'), so a comma helps; this is optional, because the imperative has no stated subject.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The first clause is an imperative with no subject of its own, so the house AWS rule does not require the comma, and the 'Lees X en jy sien Y' construction reads well without it, as the finder itself concedes.

na_skrywer.voor: aandag, hulp wanneer hy siek is, en skool
na_skrywer.na: aandag, skool en hulp wanneer hy siek is
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The house rule allows no comma before 'en' in a list; moving the item with a clause to the end removes that comma without the misreading 'wanneer hy siek is en skool', and nothing is added or left out.
na_skrywer.fout: The list ends in ', en skool', a comma before 'en' in a list, which the house comma rule does not allow.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but the fix reorders the items of a glossary definition that carries legally checked content, and a language agent may not reorder a definition, so the writer has to fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat die kinders onder meer gevra het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'van geboorte af' is the fixed expression, and the list block already uses it.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'van sy geboorte af' is natural, correct Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat die Grondwet onder meer vir elke kind gee
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: sorg by sy gesin, en gepaste ander sorg
laat_vaar_vorige.na: sorg by sy gesin en ander gepaste sorg
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: No comma before 'en' between two parts of one phrase (AWS 2017), and 'ander' naturally comes before the adjective 'gepaste'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The comma keeps the 'as hy daaruit weggeneem word' condition on the second item only, and 'gepaste ander sorg' (appropriate alternative care) would shift towards 'other appropriate care'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'rondom jou' is the clearer, more natural way to say 'around you' here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'kinders om jou' is natural Afrikaans; 'rondom jou' is only a different wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Afrikaans needs 'van' between 'lys' and what is in the list.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die lys eise' is an accepted Afrikaans construction (like ''n lys name'), so this is no grammar error and glossary wording is not reworded for style.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sê aan' reads first as 'tell to'; 'wys aan watter land' avoids the misreading.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'aan watter land ... behoort' is natural Afrikaans, and 'wys aan' would carry the same supposed misreading, so the proposal fixes nothing in a glossary entry.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: of te help leef met iets
laat_vaar_vorige.na: of te help om saam te leef met iets
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'leef met' copies English 'live with'; Afrikaans says 'saamleef met', and 'help' then takes 'om te'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'leef met' is established Afrikaans in health contexts, and the proposal makes a glossary definition longer and clumsier.
'daarvan' refers to 'hulp', and 'hulp bring' is correct; the swap would also repeat 'lewer' from the next sentence in a glossary entry.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Ook organisasies wat die staat vir hierdie werk aangewys het, lewer hierdie dienste.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Organisasies wat die staat vir hierdie werk aangewys het, lewer ook hierdie dienste.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Sentence-initial 'Ook' before a long subject reads wooden; 'ook' sits naturally after the verb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Sentence-initial 'Ook' correctly puts the focus on organisations as well as workers; moving it shifts that focus to 'also these services' in a glossary entry.
